name: CustomMonks
summary:
This is CustomMonks, a game about building! You can build anything you ever wanted! You ever wanted to build a fling car, well, you can do that! And play your builds with your friends or random people! Also try out Nation mode where you can build a nation and try to compete with other nation in the map!

:Quick note, when build you should see a red cube on your right hand with text saying build mode, this means build mode is enabled, it's in a grid so you just move your hand to change the place position of
